label: v233
changes: The person you've named to take over can now be invited straight from Who takes over — even if they've never heard of this app.

The invite carries the access with it: they sign in, and Wills & Estate opens for them. Nobody has to come back afterwards and tick a box, which matters, because the day it counts is the day you can't.
You see the exact message before you send it, and it goes out however you like — mail, WhatsApp, Signal.
If they're already in the vault, it's one tap instead: “Let them open this page”.
An invite you've sent but they haven't used shows up under Who can open this, with a way to withdraw it. Withdraw it and it grants nothing, even if they click the link afterwards.
Invites run out after 14 days. An expired one says so, and offers to send a fresh one rather than sitting there looking like it worked.
